// Weather ambience is generated locally; no external sound files or services.
window.__askAtmos=(()=>{
 let context=null,master=null,wind=null,water=null,creak=null,enabled=false,clock=0;
 const button=document.querySelector('#audio');
 function init(){if(context)return true;const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AC){button.textContent='Ljud: ej tillgängligt';return false;}
 try{context=new AC();master=context.createGain();master.gain.value=.24;master.connect(context.destination);
 const n=Math.floor(context.sampleRate*3),buf=context.createBuffer(1,n,context.sampleRate),samples=buf.getChannelData(0);let sm=0;
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){sm=sm*.94+(Math.random()*2-1)*.06;samples[i]=sm;}
 function layer(freq,volume){const src=context.createBufferSource();src.buffer=buf;src.loop=true;const filter=context.createBiquadFilter();filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.value=freq;const g=context.createGain();g.gain.value=volume;src.connect(filter);filter.connect(g);g.connect(master);src.start();return {src,g,filter};}
 wind=layer(480,.42);water=layer(160,.22);
 const osc=context.createOscillator(),g=context.createGain();osc.type='sine';osc.frequency.value=61;g.gain.value=.028;osc.connect(g);g.connect(master);osc.start();creak={osc,g};
 return true;}catch(e){button.textContent='Ljud: ej tillgängligt';return false;}}
 async function start(){if(!init())return;enabled=true;button.textContent='Ljud: på';button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');try{await context.resume()}catch{}}
 function stop(){enabled=false;button.textContent='Ljud: av';button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');context?.suspend().catch(()=>{});}
 function update(time,nearWater){if(!enabled||!context)return;if(time-clock<.15)return;clock=time;
 const now=context.currentTime;wind.g.gain.setTargetAtTime(.31+Math.sin(time*.59)*.10+Math.sin(time*1.33)*.035,now,.3);
 water.g.gain.setTargetAtTime(nearWater?.28:.08,now,.8);
 creak.g.gain.setTargetAtTime(nearWater?.052:.009,now,.7);creak.osc.frequency.setTargetAtTime(48+Math.sin(time*.87)*19,now,.12);}
 button.addEventListener('click',()=>enabled?stop():start());
 document.querySelector('#start').addEventListener('click',()=>start());
 document.querySelector('#startShip').addEventListener('click',()=>start());
 document.querySelector('#startTower').addEventListener('click',()=>start());
 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(context){if(document.hidden)context.suspend().catch(()=>{});else if(enabled)context.resume().catch(()=>{});}});
 return {start,stop,update};
})();
